svg.text: Table 11
Guiding question
Answer supported by the analysis
When does routing save while preserving quality?
When heterogeneity, calibration, and validation capability offset selection,
repetition, and operations
When does it beat simple baselines?
When gains appear under the same protocol and persist in relevant task
classes; complexity does not ensure them
What value is independent of the algorithm?
Access mediation, resource management, observation, and consistent control
enforcement
What risk follows from concentration?
A failure may reach credentials, data, configuration, and evidence across
many applications
What changes with agents and swarms?
State, delegation, concurrency, and accumulated effects make trajectory-
level evaluation necessary
What evidence supports governance?
Verifiable records of authority, policy, actual destination, consumption,
validation, and responses to change
